data.long_meaning: Nashidah refers to a song or melody, often used in Islamic religious practices, particularly in the recitation of the Quran. The term comes from the Arabic word 'nashidah', meaning 'to intone', 'to recite', or 'to chant'. The name Nashidah carries the meaning “Song, Melody, Recitation” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nashidah usually hope their child will grow to embody song, melody, recitation and live with faith, good character and purpose.
